original_test_intent: Qualify the designated ConnectX-8 PCIe endpoint and its complete host path with the owner-selected NVQual module, proving every defined subtest meets its link, function and error criteria without system hang or reboot.
original_method: Before execution, obtain the exact NVQual module/version and enumerate its reads, traffic, retrain, reset and power effects; bind ConnectX-8 serial/PN, port, PCI BDF, upstream switch/root port/retimer and supported generation/width; pin subtests, iterations, timing and acceptance; drain affected services; preserve baseline; execute one approved action at a time and retain raw module, PCIe capability/state/AER, NIC/driver and platform evidence; stop before any unspecified destructive step or at the first fault.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE supplies and explains the exact licensed NVQual qualification sequence; an operator drains dependent paths, approves any link/reset/power impact, and owns out-of-band recovery.
required_inputs: Licensed pinned NVQual ConnectX-8 PCIe qualification module, version, complete subtest list and vendor instructions
ConnectX-8 serial/PN/port/BDF and root-port/switch/retimer topology with supported and expected generation/width
Every subtest's operation, target, iterations, timing, traffic, retrain/reset/power side effects and acceptance criteria
Service isolation, operator confirmation, error/thermal/power aborts and vendor recovery
safety_requirements: Treat the unknown module as potentially disruptive until its action list is reviewed
Use a dedicated drained SUT and preserve PCIe/NIC/host/BMC baselines
Do not execute an unnamed subtest or permit reset, power, firmware or link-policy changes by default
Stop before ambiguous actions and on missing device, downtraining, link loss, AER/error burst, driver failure, hang, reboot or incomplete evidence
agent_execution_scope: Validate the exact module, target/path, subtest semantics, expectations and recovery before execution
Run only reviewed and approved module actions one at a time
Collect raw module output and target-bound PCIe/NIC/platform evidence for every action
Do not infer module identity, accept generic GPU checks as ConnectX-8 proof, cross a destructive boundary, retry faults or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Name and approve the exact NVQual module/version and all included subtests
Approve ConnectX-8 topology, maximum-link and per-subtest functional/error criteria plus disruptive-action controls
Review complete evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its lspci and log checks are useful evidence but do not define or execute the source's unspecified NVQual Test, and nvidia-smi alone does not qualify a ConnectX-8 endpoint.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Do not run a generic NVQual command; obtain the pinned ConnectX-8 module and execute only its reviewed subtests against the stable target while collecting module-specific and PCIe/NIC evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The generic NVQual Test, ConnectX-8 PCIe qualification objective, all-items/no-hang/no-reboot Criteria, no bundle, and 5/15-minute allocation remain; module number, iterations and destructive behavior are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Convert the vendor module into an approved action-and-evidence matrix before use, binding each subtest to the physical endpoint/path, expected state change, quantitative oracle and recovery boundary.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing module identity, target path, side-effect inventory, subtest-specific criteria, first-fault controls and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Generic link and GPU snapshots cannot show which ConnectX-8 functions were exercised, whether the intended lane/path was tested, or whether an internal reset/retrain recovered from a fault.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Because the module is unnamed, its blast radius could range from passive checks to traffic, link retraining or reset; execution risk cannot be reduced until the package specification is reviewed.

project_override_considerations: Another PCIe qualification suite may substitute only if the owner maps every required NVQual subtest and acceptance item to equivalent target-bound evidence. A plain lspci snapshot, GPU qualification or generic link-up check is not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner authorization, licensed module/version and reviewed subtest/action matrix
ConnectX-8 serial/PN/port/BDF and complete root-port/switch/retimer topology with LnkCap expectations
Pre-state and per-action raw NVQual output, timing, parameters, target identity and completion status
Per-action lspci capability/state/AER, NIC inventory/driver/firmware/counters, dmesg/journal and BMC/SEL/thermal/power evidence
Any abort/recovery or verified clean final target/path state
Engineer PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED decision

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Procedure consistently identify ConnectX-8 PCIe qualification using NVQual; the source is incomplete rather than internally contradictory. DeepSeek's presumed reset/power behavior remains unverified and is not adopted as source fact.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The high-level target and qualification purpose are identifiable. The exact vendor module, operations and criteria are expected supplyable artifacts, so the static review records a prerequisite rather than declaring an irreducible blocker.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2148 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00025-V002: provide and approve the exact licensed NVQual module/version and complete subtest list, ConnectX-8 serial/PN/port/BDF with root-port/switch/retimer topology and expected generation/width, every subtest's traffic/retrain/reset/power semantics, iterations/timing, link/function/AER/error acceptance, isolation, aborts, and recovery.

review_improvement: Prevents an unnamed vendor test or GPU-centric snapshot from being treated as ConnectX-8 qualification and establishes a reviewable action/evidence contract before any disruptive operation.
independent_technical_reasoning: A vendor suite name is not an executable specification: different NVQual modules can be passive, traffic-producing, retraining or reset-inducing, and each requires different interlocks. ConnectX-8 acceptance also depends on the exact upstream PCIe path rather than GPU inventory. Therefore static review can preserve the intended qualification while requiring the module package as a supplyable prerequisite; execution cannot start until each subtest's target, effect and oracle are explicit.
